name: segmented-control
title: Segmented control
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A small set of related choices. Arrow keys move the selection and the highlight glides.

meta.descriptionEs: Un conjunto pequeño de opciones. Las flechas mueven la selección y el resalte se desliza.

examples.title: Control segmentado
examples.description: Un conjunto pequeño de opciones. Las flechas mueven la selección y el resalte se desliza.

api.name: options
api.description: value, label, an optional icon, and an optional accessory. iconsOnly keeps the label for assistive tech.

api.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
api.description: Selected value. Omit value for internal state.

api.name: onOptionIntent
api.description: Pointer or focus reached an option before it was chosen.

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
